intro: Uganda is a presidential republic where Yoweri Museveni has held power since 1986.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Term and age limits for the president have been removed. Parliament is dominated by the ruling NRM party, and opposition figures have been arrested. Traditional kingdoms have a cultural role.

chapters.title: Rights
text: A 2023 law against homosexuality drew strong international criticism.

keyTerms.meaning: The National Resistance Movement, the ruling party.
